parameters.content:
## 🔵 Start Here

This workflow reads a blog post from GitHub and checks it for quality issues using two AI agents.

Edit the **Set Input Variables** node to change which repo and file to QA.

The workflow will:
1. Fetch the blog post
2. Find quality issues (Agent 1)
3. Create fix instructions (Agent 2)
4. Apply fixes safely
5. Open a Pull Request for human review

## 🟢 Step 1: Find Issues

The QA agent reads the blog post and looks for problems like unclear writing, tone issues, or grammar mistakes.

It outputs a quality score and a list of specific issues with line numbers.

## 🟡 Are There Issues?

If the blog post has no issues, we stop here — the article is clean.

If issues are found, we continue to fix them.

## 🟢 Step 2: Create Fix Instructions

The editor agent takes the list of issues and creates specific instructions for how to fix each one — which lines to change and what the new text should be.

## 🟠 Step 3: Apply Fixes Safely

This code applies the fixes one by one. It checks each fix is valid before applying it.

Safety features:
• Checks original text matches (conflict detection)
• Skips invalid line numbers
• Aborts if >50% of lines would change

## 🟣 Step 4: Submit for Review

The fixed blog post and a QA report are committed to a new branch and a Pull Request is opened.

A human reviews and approves the changes before they go live. The AI never writes directly to the main branch.
